docs.title: About
docs.text:
I am a Data Science / Data Engineering-focused student based in Braunschweig, Germany. I enjoy building practical data products, from data pipelines and analytics layers to ML workflows, with a focus on performance, scalability, and maintainability.

Current interests: Spark/Databricks - Azure/AWS - ML pipelines - Data Engineering - Software Engineering

docs.title: Skills
docs.text:
• Programming Languages: C, C++, Python, SQL
  • ML/DS: scikit-learn, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, model evaluation, hyperparameter tuning
  • Data Engineering: Azure Data Factory, Databricks, PySpark, Delta/Medallion architecture, Data Warehousing
  • Cloud: Azure (Functions, Logic Apps, Data Lake Gen2, DevOps), AWS (SageMaker, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch)
  • BI/Tools: Power BI, Git, VS Code, SSMS

docs.title: Data Science Intern — Volkswagen Financial Services (Braunschweig, Germany)
docs.text:
Apr 2025 – Sep 2025

  • Researched and implemented ensemble learning techniques, including bagging, feature selection, meta-modeling, and hyperparameter tuning to improve model performance.
  • Analyzed transformer-based models for tabular data.
  • Developed, tested, and optimized Python code for machine learning workflows, ensuring scalability and maintainability.
  • Collaborated with the data science team to evaluate model results and recommend performance enhancements.
  • Hands-on with AWS (SageMaker, S3, CloudWatch, Lambda).

docs.title: Student Assistant — Institut fur Eisenbahnwesen und Verkehrssicherung, TU Braunschweig (Braunschweig, Germany)
docs.text:
Nov 2024 – Sep 2025

  • Researched methods to measure train speed in LEGO model trains using sensors (including wheel rotation sensors) to calculate speed and distance traveled.
  • Developed a Python-based control tool with Tkinter for a user-friendly interface, enabling train operation via Bluetooth Low Energy.
  • Implemented connectivity to an ESP32 board for real-time control and management of the train system.

docs.title: Full Stack Engineering Senior Analyst — Accenture Technology (Bengaluru, India)
docs.text:
Dec 2021 – Oct 2023

  • Designed and implemented end-to-end data solutions leveraging Azure services, Power Platform, and Databricks for automated data onboarding into the data lakehouse/data marketplace.
  • Built and tested ETL pipelines in Azure Data Factory with linked services, datasets, activities, and pipeline orchestration.
  • Implemented Azure Functions using Python scripts and workflows in Azure Logic Apps.
  • Ingested data from Dynamics CRM, Reddit APIs, SAP Hana, and Salesforce.
  • Applied medallion architecture and Databricks/PySpark transformations to curate data for downstream applications.

docs.title: Full Stack Engineering Analyst — Accenture Technology (Mumbai, India)
docs.text:
Oct 2020 – Nov 2021

  • Built data ingestion from FTP and SQL using full and delta loads in Azure Data Factory.
  • Performed data curation and data reconciliation with Databricks integration and PySpark transformations.
  • Delivered Azure Synapse Analytics data loads using blob triggers for pipeline execution and data warehousing.
  • Created data models for Power BI visualizations via Azure Analysis Services.
  • Implemented logging for data load pipelines using Azure Log Analytics.
